title: The framing of decision situations 2000-2001
authors: C. Steglich, R.U. Groningen, Sociologie/ICS (primary investigator)
contributors: C. Steglich, R.U. Groningen, Sociologie/ICS, Sociologie/ICS (data collector)
descriptions: The experimental data were collected for testing predictive and descriptive accuracy of framing theory. Altogether four experiments are reported, namely: an iterated social dilemma experiment, a study on effects of choice set composition in decision making, a study on effects of non-informative information in decision making, and a study on effects of preceding decisions on decision making. Framing / decision making / context-dependent preferences / social dilemma / normative behaviour
